text: The shirt sponsor 'Ayuntamiento de Benahavís' is the Ayuntamiento de Benahavís itself, the town council of Benahavís (Málaga province): its official municipal website carries the council's name and NIF P2902300I.
short: The sponsor is the town council of Benahavís itself (NIF P2902300I).
